test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, who is the Vice President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M Venkaiah Naidu.**__

__
 
• **Muppavarapu Venkaiah Naidu **is an Indian politician serving as the** 13th vice president of India since 2017.**
 
• Jagdeep Dhankar is the 14th and current Vice President of India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Article 63 of the Constitution of India provides that there shall be a Vice-President of India.
 
• Articles 64 and 89 provide that the Vice-President of India shall be the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha and shall not hold any other office of profit.
 
• The Vice-President of India will preside over the Upper House and will act as the President in certain contingent situations.
 
• Thus, the Vice President of India has been assigned a dual role, as the second Chief of the Executive and as the Presiding Officer of the Upper House of Parliament.
 
• The Vice-President is elected by a single transferable vote according to the proportional representation method by the electorate consisting of members of both houses of Parliament.
